messages.content: 一輛汽車從靜止開始，10秒內行駛了120公尺的距離。在這段時間結束時，汽車的速度是多少？在達到這個速度後，汽車繼續加速5秒，從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍。最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍。在第二階段，汽車的加速度是多少？

function.name: kinematics_calculate_acceleration
function.description: Calculates the acceleration of an object under given conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the object. This is a float type value.

final_speed.description: The final speed of the object. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds it took the object to reach the final speed. This is a float type value.

distance.description: The distance in meters the object has traveled. This is a float type value.

function.name: kinematics_calculate_speed_from_rest
function.description: Calculates the speed of an object that starts from rest under a constant acceleration over a specified distance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

distance.description: The distance in meters the object has traveled. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds it took the object to travel. This is a float type value.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the object. This is a float type value.

message.reasoning:
We need to compute first part: car starts from rest, 10s, distance 120m. We need final speed at end of this period. Use kinematics: distance = v_initial * t + 0.5 * a * t^2. v_initial=0, so 120 = 0.5 * a * 10^2 = 0.5 * a * 100 = 50a => a = 120/50 = 2.4 m/s^2. Final speed after 10s: v_final = v_initial + a*t = 0 + 2.4*10 = 24 m/s. So first part speed = 24 m/s.

Second part: car continues accelerating 5s, from 12 m/s to final speed which is twice the initial speed? Wait: "從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍" Means from 12 m/s accelerate to final speed that is twice the initial speed. But initial speed for second stage? It says "最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍" So final speed after second stage is twice the speed computed in first part (24 m/s). So final speed = 48 m/s. Starting speed for second stage is 12 m/s? But earlier says "從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍". That seems contradictory: if starting speed is 12 m/s, final speed is twice the initial speed of second stage? That would be 24 m/s. But then they say final speed is twice the speed from first part (24 m/s) => 48 m/s. So maybe they mean: after first part, car continues accelerating 5s, from 12 m/s to final speed that is twice the initial speed of first part? Wait: Let's parse Chinese: "在達到這個速度後，汽車繼續加速5秒，從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍。最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍。" So after reaching 24 m/s, car continues accelerating 5s, from 12 m/s accelerate to final speed that is twice the initial speed. But initial speed for second stage is 12 m/s? That seems weird because car was at 24 m/s at end of first stage. Maybe they mean: after first stage, car continues accelerating 5s, from 12 m/s accelerate to final speed that is twice the initial speed of first part? Actually "初始速度" could refer to the initial speed of the second stage? But they also say final speed is twice the speed from first part. So maybe they mean: second stage starts at 12 m/s (maybe car slowed down?), but final speed is twice the speed from first part (48 m/s). So we have start speed 12 m/s, end speed 48 m/s, time 5s. Compute acceleration: a = (v_final - v_initial)/t = (48-12)/5 = 36/5 = 7.2 m/s^2. That seems plausible.

But we need to use tool kinematics_calculate_acceleration. Provide initial_speed=12, final_speed=48, time=5. distance optional. We'll call tool.
